implemented_requirements.requirement: Group 16 words into four sets of four based on hidden categories
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.allWords() aggregates words from puzzle.categories; findMatchingCategory() checks a 4‑word selection against a category.

index.html contains a
; UI.renderGrid() builds tiles for game.remainingWords.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Player selects four at a time to form a group
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.toggleWord() adds/removes words from a Set called selected; selection limited to 4 items.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Correct groups are removed and revealed with a category and a color‑coded difficulty (yellow, green, blue, purple)
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.submitGuess() on a correct match pushes the category to solvedGroups, removes its words from remainingWords, and UI.renderSolvedGroups() displays a banner with the category and its difficulty.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Incorrect guesses count as mistakes, with a maximum of four allowed
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.maxMistakes = 4; mistakesMade increments on wrong guess; status becomes 'lost' when mistakes reach the limit.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Only one correct solution exists, even though words may appear to fit multiple categories
implemented_requirements.evidence: puzzles.js validates each puzzle for unique words and distinct categories; comment states exactly one solution exists.
Game.shuffleRemaining() performs a Fisher‑Yates shuffle; UI.handleShuffle() triggers it.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Provide immediate feedback after each guess
implemented_requirements.evidence: UI.handleCorrect() and UI.handleIncorrect() are called from Game.submitGuess() result; messages and visual effects are applied instantly.

implemented_requirements.requirement: A new puzzle is generated daily
implemented_requirements.evidence: daily.js computes day number and selects a puzzle from PUZZLES based on that number.

critical_issues: game.js contains an incomplete static deserialize method with a literal "..." placeholder, which is invalid JavaScript syntax and will cause a runtime parse error, preventing the script from loading.
style.css file contains only the placeholder text "FILENAME" and no actual CSS, so the UI will render without styling, though functionality may still work.

UI class implementation is only partially shown; without the full code it is unclear whether all DOM interactions (e.g., enabling/disabling the Submit button, rendering the 4×4 layout, showing color‑coded difficulty) are correctly wired.
judge.summary: The codebase demonstrates most of the core gameplay mechanics: daily puzzle selection, word shuffling, selection of four words, validation against hidden categories, mistake tracking, and feedback handling. However, a fatal syntax error in Game.deserialize and missing CSS mean the application cannot run as‑is, and the incomplete UI implementation leaves doubt about full visual compliance. Because of these critical issues, the submission does not meet the pass criteria.
